arxiv-2212-05922.title: Audiovisual Masked Autoencoders
arxiv-2212-05922.creator: Mariana-Iuliana Georgescu, Eduardo Fonseca, Radu Tudor Ionescu, Mario Lucic, Cordelia Schmid, Anurag Arnab
arxiv-2212-05922.description: Abstract Can we leverage the audiovisual information already present in video to improve self-supervised representation learning? To answer this question, we study various pretraining architectures and objectives within the masked autoencoding framework, motivated by the success of similar methods in natural language and image understanding.

arxiv-2304-00587.title: Well Posedness and Characterization of Solutions to Non Conservative Products in Non Homogeneous Fluid Dynamics Equations
arxiv-2304-00587.creator: Rinaldo M. Colombo, Graziano Guerra, Yannick Holle
arxiv-2304-00587.description: Abstract Consider a balance law where the flux depends explicitly on the space variable. At jump discontinuities, modeling considerations may impose the defect in the conservation of some quantities, thus leading to non conservative products. Below, we deduce the evolution in the smooth case from the jump conditions at discontinuities.

arxiv-2306-02455.title: Raman Sideband Cooling of Molecules in an Optical Tweezer Array
arxiv-2306-02455.creator: Yukai Lu, Samuel J. Li, Connor M. Holland, Lawrence W. Cheuk
arxiv-2306-02455.description: Abstract Ultracold molecules, because of their rich internal structures and interactions, have been proposed as a promising platform for quantum science and precision measurement. Direct laser-cooling promises to be a rapid and efficient way to bring molecules to ultracold temperatures. For trapped molecules, laser-cooling to the quantum motional ground state remains an outstanding challenge.

arxiv-2307-11902.title: Background Pycnocline depth constrains Future Ocean Heat Uptake Efficiency
arxiv-2307-11902.description: Abstract The Ocean Heat Uptake Efficiency (OHUE) quantifies the ocean’s ability to mitigate surface warming through deep heat sequestration. Despite its importance, the main controls on OHUE, as well as its nearly two-fold spread across contemporary climate models, remain unclear.

arxiv-2310-03664.title: Certification of Deep Learning Models for Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2310-03664.creator: Othmane Laousy, Alexandre Araujo, Guillaume Chassagnon, Nikos Paragios, Marie-Pierre Revel, Maria Vakalopoulou
arxiv-2310-03664.description: Abstract In medical imaging, segmentation models have known a significant improvement in the past decade and are now used daily in clinical practice. However, similar to classification models, segmentation models are affected by adversarial attacks. In a safety-critical field like healthcare, certifying model predictions is of the utmost importance.

arxiv-2410-23746.title: DetectRL : Benchmarking LLM-Generated Text Detection in Real-World Scenarios
arxiv-2410-23746.creator: Junchao Wu Runzhe Zhan Derek F. Wong Shu Yang, Xinyi Yang Yulin Yuan Lidia S. Chao
arxiv-2410-23746.description: Abstract Detecting text generated by large language models (LLMs) is of great recent interest. With zero-shot methods like DetectGPT, detection capabilities have reached impressive levels. However, the reliability of existing detectors in real-world applications remains underexplored. In this study, we present a new benchmark, DetectRL , highlighting that even state-of-the-art (SOTA) detection techniques still underperformed in this task.

arxiv-2504-15604.title: Exploring Next Token Prediction in Theory of Mind (ToM) Tasks: Comparative Experiments with GPT-2 and LLaMA-2 AI Models
arxiv-2504-15604.creator: Pavan Yadav, Krishna Shinde, Nikhil Khandalkar, Lokesh B. Ramegowda, Rajarshi Das
arxiv-2504-15604.description: Abstract Language models have significantly advanced in their ability to generate coherent text and predict subsequent tokens based on given prompts. This study systematically compares the next-token prediction performance of two widely recognized models: OpenAI’s GPT-2 and Meta’s Llama-2-7b-chat-hf in Theory of Mind (ToM) tasks.

arxiv-2508-17057.title: GRAID : Synthetic Data Generation with Geometric Constraints and Multi-Agentic Reflection for Harmful Content Detection
arxiv-2508-17057.creator: Melissa Kazemi Rad, Alberto Purpura, Himanshu Kumar, Emily Chen
arxiv-2508-17057.description: Abstract We address the problem of data scarcity in harmful text classification for guardrailing applications and introduce Graid ( G eometric and R eflective AI -Driven D ata Augmentation), a novel pipeline that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) for dataset augmentation.

arxiv-2603-23407.title: Encoding Numerical Data for Generative Quantum Machine Learning
arxiv-2603-23407.creator: Michael Krebsbach, Hagen-Henrik Kowalski, Florentin Reiter, Ali Abedi, Thomas Wellens

pmc-10694947.title: Induction of CYP3A activity by dexamethasone may not be strong, even at high doses: insights from a case of tacrolimus co-administration
pmc-10694947.creator: Yoshiyuki Ohno, Toyohito Oriyama, Akira Honda, Mineo Kurokawa, Tappei Takada
pmc-10694947.description: BackgroundDexamethasone (DEX) induces CYP3A activity in a concentration-dependent manner. However, no study has examined changes in the blood concentration of CYP3A substrate drugs when DEX is administered at high doses. Herein, we present a case in which tacrolimus (TAC), a typical CYP3A substrate drug, was co-administered with a chemotherapy regimen that included high-dose DEX.

pmc-10702525.title: Effect-Directed Analysis Combined with Nontarget Screening to Identify Unmonitored Toxic Substances in the Environment
pmc-10702525.creator: Seongjin Hong, Junghyun Lee, Jihyun Cha, Jiyun Gwak, Jong Seong Khim
pmc-10702525.description: Effect-directed analysis (EDA) combined with nontarget screening (NTS) has established a valuable tool for the identification of unmonitored toxic substances in environmental samples. It consists of three main steps: (1) highly potent fraction identification, (2) toxicant candidate selection, and (3) major toxicant identification. Here, we discuss the methodology, current status, limitations, and future challenges of EDA combined with NTS.

pmc-11375258.title: Anxiety and Depression Associated With Increased Cardiovascular Disease Risk Through Accelerated Development of Risk Factors
pmc-11375258.creator: Giovanni Civieri, Shady Abohashem, Simran S Grewal, Wesam Aldosoky, Iqra Qamar, Erin Hanlon, Karmel W Choi, Lisa M Shin, Rachel P Rosovsky, Sandeep Chandra Bollepalli, Hui Chong Lau, Antonis Armoundas, Antonia V Seligowski, Sarah M Turgeon, Roger K Pitman, Francesco Tona, Jason H Wasfy, Jordan W Smo
pmc-11375258.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundPrior studies have incompletely assessed whether the development of cardiometabolic risk factors (CVDRF) (hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and diabetes mellitus) mediates the association between anxiety and depression (anxiety/depression) and cardiovascular disease (CVD).ObjectivesThe authors aimed to evaluate the following: 1) the association between anxiety/depression and incident CVDRFs and whether this association mediates the increased CVD risk; and 2) whether neuro-immune mechanisms and age and sex effects may be involved.MethodsUsing a retrospective cohort design, Mass General Brigham Biobank subjects were followed for 10 years.

pmc-11415709.title: Effects of grading rubrics on EFL learners’ writing in an EMI setting
pmc-11415709.creator: Talal Musaed Alghizzi, Tahani Munahi Alshahrani
pmc-11415709.description: Despite considerable evidence that supports the use of grading rubrics (GRs) as tools for written corrective feedback, there is a paucity of research that investigates which of the different types of GRs best develops learners' International English Language Testing System (IELTS) writing scores in English as a medium of instruction (EMI)-contested settings.

pmc-11518019.title: Mortality related to different circulatory diseases: a multiple causes of death analysis, 2008-2022
pmc-11518019.creator: U Fedeli, V Casotto
pmc-11518019.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundMortality from circulatory diseases significantly increased in 2020 compared to pre-pandemic years in many countries. However, data were mostly limited to the underlying cause of death and to the first phases of the pandemic.

pmc-11652287.title: Sex Disparities Affecting Postoperative Outcomes After Total Elbow Arthroplasty
pmc-11652287.creator: Rohit Siddabattula, George Thomas, Urska Cvek, Marjan Trutschl, Edward Wu, Allison J. Rao
pmc-11652287.description: PurposeTo investigate sex disparities in 30-day postoperative outcomes of total elbow arthroplasty.MethodsThe American College of Surgeons-National Surgical Quality Improvement Program files were queried for all patients who underwent a total elbow arthroplasty (TEA) between 2006 and 2020. Sex disparities in preoperative variables were studied using Fisher exact tests.

pmc-11808839.title: Refining the Choosing Health Infant feeding for Infant Health intervention and implementation strategy: Re-CHErIsH Study Protocol
pmc-11808839.creator: Eibhlín Looney, Moira Duffy, Helen Ahern Galvin, Molly Byrne, Rebecca Golley, Catherine Hayes, Tony Heffernan, Aisling Jennings, Brittany Johnson, Patricia M Kearney, Colette Kelly, Patricia Leahy-Warren, Marian McBride, Sheena McHugh, Kate O’Neill, Sarah Redsell, Anna Lene Seidler, Elaine Toomey, K
pmc-11808839.description: BackgroundChildhood obesity is a significant global public health challenge, with significant adverse effects on both mental and physical health outcomes. During the period from birth to one-year, modifiable caregiver behaviours, such as what, how and when infants are fed, can influence obesity development and prevention.

pmc-12450561.title: Post-reduction reclassification dilemma in proximal humeral fracture-dislocation: A case report and practical considerations
pmc-12450561.creator: Sang Anh Nguyen, Doanh Quoc Tran
pmc-12450561.description: IntroductionProximal humeral fracture-dislocations (PHF-D) are complex injuries, often requiring urgent intervention. However, management protocols remain unclear when anatomical reduction of the glenohumeral joint is achieved, but significant displacement of the greater tuberosity persists. The lack of consensus on whether to reclassify such injuries after reduction creates uncertainty in rehabilitation strategies.

pmc-12502640.title: “We knew it was coming: we didn’t act” perspectives from people who use drugs and substance use workforce on the impact of delays in implementation of the supervised injection facility and drug checking interventions
pmc-12502640.creator: Margaret R Hester, Jaclyn M W Hughto, Divya Ravikumar-Grant, Saoirse Nic Gabhainn
pmc-12502640.description: BackgroundHarm reduction techniques such as supervised injection facilities and drug checking are evidence-based strategies for reducing fatal overdoses. Despite the evidence in support of these interventions, Irish drug policy experienced delays in implementation of these strategies. This study considers the perceived impacts of delayed implementation of the supervised injection facility and drug checking in Ireland.

pmc-12542521.title: Prevalence of knee osteoarthritis in the Chinese population, 2013–2023: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12542521.creator: Xin Chen, Changli Shao, Li Li, Zheng Zuo, Yan Wang
pmc-12542521.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveKnee osteoarthritis (KOA) is the primary cause of lower-limb disability and poses a substantial socio-economic burden. This systematic review and meta-analysis aims to assess the prevalence of KOA in the Chinese population between 2013 and 2023.MethodsEight databases were searched, in addition to a grey Literature search and manual retrieval, to comprehensively collect cross-sectional studies on the prevalence of KOA in China. Stata 18.0 was used to perform a meta-analysis of the KOA prevalence data included in this study.

pmc-13243643.title: Sustainable recycling of polyester wastes using a coordinatively unsaturated Zn catalyst
pmc-13243643.creator: Jingjing Cao, Huaxing Liang, Wei Chen, Xiaodong Li, Shaohai Fu
pmc-13243643.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Closed-loop recycling of polyester waste offers a promising route for addressing the environmental burden of plastic pollution and enabling resource circularity. However, current polyester plastic recycling methods face limitations in industrial scalability and environmental impact. Here, we report the development of a low-cost, earth-abundant, coordinatively unsaturated defect–zinc oxide (d–ZnO) catalyst for the efficient depolymerization of various polyester wastes, including polyethylene terephthalate, biodegradable polyesters, post-consumer polyesters, and mixed polyester waste.

pmc-13352765.title: Coxmos: interpretable survival models for high-dimensional and multi-omic data
pmc-13352765.creator: Pedro Salguero, Anabel Buendía-Galera, Sonia Tarazona
pmc-13352765.description: BackgroundSurvival analysis in high-dimensional (HD) and multi-block (MB) settings, such as omic and multi-omic studies, poses major methodological challenges due to multicollinearity, low events-per-variable ratios, and limited model interpretability. While Cox Proportional Hazards models remain widely used, their applicability is restricted in HD scenarios. Machine learning approaches can handle such complexity but often lack interpretability.

pmc-13385628.title: Debris variability and velocity estimation using Electrical Resistivity Tomography and DInSAR techniques of Durung Drung glacier, northwestern Himalaya
pmc-13385628.creator: Avtar Singh Jasrotia, Suhail Ahmad, Amit Sharma, Nikhil Kumar, Praveen Kumar Thakur, Sushil Kumar Singh, Komal Kumar Singh, Pushup Mahajan, Akarshan Rasyal
pmc-13385628.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study integrates Electrical Resistivity Tomography (ERT), Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), and DGPS measurements to characterize the glacier dynamics, subsurface conditions, and moraine stability of the Durung Drung Glacier in the northwestern Himalaya. ERT profiles reaching depths of ~ 45 m resolves a distinct three-layer subsurface architecture composed of a low-resistivity, water-saturated surface layer, an intermediate zone of frozen sediments containing discontinuous ground-ice lenses, and a high-resistivity crystalline bedrock unit.

pmc-13471495.title: pyVIPER: a fast and scalable Python package for protein activity estimation and master regulator analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing data
pmc-13471495.creator: Alexander L. E. Wang, Luca Zanella, Zizhao Lin, Filippo Riva, Heeju Noh, Gabriel M. Aizenman, Lukas Vlahos, Miquel Anglada-Girotto, Rowan Cassius, Léo Dupire, Aziz Zafar, Andrea Califano, Alessandro Vasciaveo

pmc-13501820.title: Integrating machine learning and retrospective cohort to explore the effects of AEDs on the prognosis of LGG and identify related molecular targets
pmc-13501820.creator: Ming Zhou, Qinhong Huang, Hui Liang, Hanjie Yang, Min Li

pmc-13575056.title: Before the task begins: linking resting-state gamma oscillations to face-name associative memory
pmc-13575056.creator: Gaetano Scianatico, Giorgia Francesca Scaramuzzi, Ece Çağlayan, Anna Concetta Spina, Ester Cornacchia, Volker Thoma, Paolo Taurisano, Davide Rivolta, Valerio Manippa
pmc-13575056.description: Assessing associative memory, particularly in complex paradigms such as face-name association, enables monitoring of cognitive functioning. Electrophysiological correlates of associative memory could provide fundamental insights into the functional role of brain dynamics. This study explored whether resting-state EEG (rsEEG) spectral power and coherence were associated with performance on the Italian Face-Name Association Test (ItFNAT).
